newsitem.title: USA: R.R. Donnelley hit by discrimination suit.
newsitem.headline: R.R. Donnelley hit by discrimination suit.

text.p: R.R. Donnelley & Sons Co said on Tuesday that African-American former employees of the company filed a class-action lawsuit alleging racial discrimination in connection with a 1993 plant closing.
The printing company denied the charges in the suit, which seeks $500 million in damages.
In a statement, R.R. Donnelley said it was "outraged at the inflammatory accusations and characterizations of the company as alleged in a lawsuit filed in federal court in Chicago Monday."
The company said it would vigorously defend its actions in regard to the closing of its Chicago manufacturing division.
R.R. Donnelley said it shut down the printing plant after retailer Sears, Roebuck & Co decided to discontinue its large catalog.
